title: Blindweed
wikitext:
'''Blindweed''' is an [[Herb]] that can be gathered with [[Herbalism]] (235).

==Source==
Blindweed can be found near stagnant water and along the shorelines of lakes and waterways in [[Feralas]].

==Patch changes==
*Patch 1.8.0: Blindweed has been increased in size, making it easier to see.
